To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a scalar field interacting through a Yukawa potential with a field whose false vacuum is nucleated by an O(4) -symmetric bubble has a quantum state inside the bubble that is Lorentz invariant, but very different from Minkowski vacuum.

(1) the nucleated bubble has an O(4) symmetric quantum state which is not the Minkowski state, and (2) the quantum state inside of a nucleated bubble is not Lorentz invariant, which implies that the bubble is not an open universe.

the false vacuum decay of a scalar field in the presence of another scalar field whose false vacuum decay is described by a Euclidean O4 -symmetric bubble is accompanied by the production of thermal radiation in the resulting state.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the quantum state of scalar fields in curved spacetime.
the quantum state of the scalar field inside the nucleated Euclidean O( 4)-symmetric bubbles.
the quantum state of scalar fields inside and outside of a nucleated bubble, and with its implications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the nucleation of a bubble of a false vacuum is not a process in which the false vacuum decays to a state which is close to the Minkowski vaccuum.
, in the context of the false vacuum decay, the WKB tunneling approach is not applicable to the description of the quantum state of the field during and after the nucleation of an bubble.
the quantum state after nucleation of a bubble is Lorent­ z-invariant but very far from being a vacuum state.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the nucleation of an Euclidean O( 4)-symmetric false vacuum bubble is a process in which the quantum state of the scalar field is changed from the Minkowskian vacuum to a state which is Lorentz invariant and very different from the vacuum state.
we have shown that the false vacuum decay can be treated in a quantum mechanical way.

we have shown that the quantum state of the scalar field inside an O(4) -symmetric bubble is not Minkowski vacuum but contains field excitations which are very similar to thermal radiation at late stages of the bubble nucleation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the quantum state of the field inside the bubble is not the Minkowski vaccuum.
, even though the quantum state of the scalar field is not the Minkowski vaccum, it is not a pure state either.
